items.source_en:
From: Wynn Akasaka
Subject: Re - About the other night
Date: 7 Helona, 7968 C.RC


Haukea,  
The other day when you invited me to the security checkpoint for some "hand-to hand combat training," I was not myself. In fact, if I took a blood-alcohol test at the time, I think I could have actually proven this, legally. 

As it stands, I cannot. I don't even remember the thing that didn't happen. So if you could clear this up with Leanna, and tell her this non-fact, I'd appreciate it.

P.S. I get that what didn't happen left a trail of physical evidence implying that it actually DID happen, but maybe you can convince her it was basically nothing? 

Damnit, I'm screwed, aren't I.

items.source_en:
PLANET: Freya III
SPECIFIC GRAVITY: 0.82G
HABITABLE ATMOSPHERE: Y
HABITABLE TEMPERATURE: Y
LOCAL ECOSYSTEM: Complete (Micro, Flora, Fauna)

ANALYSIS:
This is a nightmare world.

Oh, sure, scans look nice. Breathable atmosphere, near-Taris gravity, habitable temps at the mid latitudes, fully-established ecosystem. Maybe even some useful organics.

Don't let it fool you. Everything here is out to get you. The apex predators, Cataxi, are burrowing carnivores with near-impenetrable shells and deadly venom. The herbivores are aggressive and wildly territorial. Local flora defends itself with some of the strongest psychotropics we've seen. Even the oceans are polluted with heavy metals and organic compounds that'll melt your skin if you aren't protected.

If we have to set up a facility here, we need a high-end electric pulse field to keep the fauna at bay, and a full-time doctor and security team on standby in case some idiot decides to go for a walk.

분석:
이곳은 악몽 같은 세상이다.

물론 스캔 결과는 좋아 보인다. 호흡 가능한 대기, 타리스와 비슷한 중력, 중위도의 거주 가능한 온도, 완전히 정착된 생태계까지. 어쩌면 유용한 유기체도 있을지 모른다.

하지만 속지 마라. 이곳의 모든 것은 당신을 노리고 있다. 최상위 포식자인 카탁시는 뚫기 힘든 껍질과 치명적인 독을 가진 굴을 파는 육식동물이다. 초식동물조차 공격적이고 영토 의식이 강하다. 이곳의 식물들은 우리가 본 것 중 가장 강력한 향정신성 물질로 스스로를 방어한다. 바다조차도 보호 장비가 없으면 피부를 녹여버릴 중금속과 유기 화합물로 오염되어 있다.

이곳에 시설을 세워야 한다면, 동물을 쫓아낼 고성능 전기 펄스 필드가 필요하며, 누군가 멍청하게 산책이라도 나갈 경우를 대비해 상주 의사와 보안팀이 대기하고 있어야 한다.
